name: AssignedHours
query:
LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS
FROM 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lordmin33/Advanced-databases/refs/heads/main/Assignment3/Assigned_Hours.csv'
AS row

CREATE (:AssignedHours {
  courseCode: row["Course code"],
  studyPeriod: row["Study Period"],
  academicYear: row["Academic Year"],
  teacherId: row["Teacher Id"],
  hours: toFloat(row["Hours"]),
  courseInstance: row["Course Instance"]
});

name: Courses
query:
LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS
FROM 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lordmin33/Advanced-databases/refs/heads/main/Assignment3/Courses.csv'
AS row

CREATE (:Course {
  courseName: row["Course name"],
  courseCode: row["Course code"],
  credits: toFloat(row["Credits"]),
  level: row["Level"],
  department: row["Department"],
  division: row["Division"],
  ownedBy: row["Owned By"]
});

query:
MATCH (p :Programme)

name: Query 2
query:
MATCH (ta :TeachingAssistant {divisionName:'D3-2'})
WITH ta.divisionName AS divisionName, ta.teacherName AS name
MATCH (c :Course {division: divisionName})
WITH c.courseCode AS code, name
MATCH (ci :CourseInstance {courseCode: code, studyPeriod: 2, academicYear: '2023-2024'})
RETURN name, count(*) AS nrOfCourses

name: Query 3
query:
MATCH (ah :AssignedHours {courseCode: '1015'})
FILTER ah.hours > 120
WITH ah.courseInstance AS instance, ah.teacherId AS teacher
MATCH (c :CourseInstance {instanceId: instance, studyPeriod: 1, academicYear: "2018-2019"})
WITH teacher
CALL () {
  MATCH (st :SeniorTeacher)
  RETURN st.teacherName AS name, st.teacherId AS id
UNION
  MATCH (ta :TeachingAssistant)
  RETURN ta.teacherName AS name, ta.teacherId AS id
}
FILTER teacher = id
RETURN name

name: Query 4
query:
MATCH (r :Registration {courseInstance: 'I-910'})
FILTER r.courseInstance <> 'I-911'
RETURN r.studentId AS studentID, r.courseInstance AS instanceID

name: Query 5
query:
MATCH (c :Course)
WITH c.ownedBy AS program
MATCH (p :Programme {programmeName: program})
RETURN p.programmeName AS program, count(*) AS courseCount
ORDER BY courseCount DESC
